intent: PSI-061: Migration M6 Google — Drive mirror, document views, Google calendar links, push triggers and sync schedules.
summary: Implemented supabase/migrations/20260926040000_m6_google.sql with drive_roots, drive_root_access, drive_files (pg_trgm GIN index), document_views, google_calendars, event_google_links, can_see_drive_root() RLS helper, google push triggers via pg_net, upsert_google_event() and prune_google_events() service-role helpers, and pg_cron schedules. Added supabase/tests/google.test.sql (8 pgTAP assertions) proving a user without root access sees zero roots or files.

decisions.decision: Use pg_trgm GIN index on drive_files.name in the extensions schema
decisions.reason: Enables fast substring and fuzzy document search without external search infrastructure.

decisions.decision: Enforce XOR (num_nonnulls = 1) on drive_root_access and google_calendars
decisions.reason: Guarantees each access grant or calendar maps to exactly one role or one group, keeping RLS resolution deterministic.

decisions.decision: Capture event_google_links in a BEFORE DELETE trigger
decisions.reason: The link rows cascade away with the event, so the delete push payload must be built before the cascade runs.

verification.manual: Verified database migration and 8 pgTAP assertions for Google Workspace RLS and constraints.

human_review.reason: Awaiting human operator review stamp on PSI-061 card.
